purpose: Non-destructive cleanup and delete candidate inventory for the project layout/runtime boundary plan.

candidate_groups.decision: Removed from repository root after confirming app/electron/main/main.cjs is the active Electron main source.

resolution.reason: app/electron/package.json uses main/main.cjs and repository references point to app/electron/main/main.cjs rather than root main.cjs.

candidate_groups.decision: Removed from repository source ownership after confirming app/web/remote is the served canonical Remote Web source.

resolution.reason: FastAPI and Electron set or resolve Remote Web to app/web/remote; ui/remote_web was release-excluded and only retained direct test/documentation references.

candidate_groups.decision: Keep out of source ownership and release source staging. Do not delete automatically because these may contain local user state.
candidate_groups.replacement: runtime user-data or generated build output

candidate_groups.decision: Release-excluded local samples/debug files. Remove only after owner confirms they are not useful local references.
candidate_groups.replacement: release_assets/samples for reviewed tiny samples, otherwise runtime/output storage

candidate_groups.decision: Keep local test, coverage, and Python bytecode caches out of source ownership and release source staging. Do not delete automatically because ACLs can make cache cleanup destructive in this workspace.
candidate_groups.replacement: ephemeral test/cache output outside tracked source

candidate_groups.decision: Do not delete until WebSession feature parity gates pass and missing features are migrated.
candidate_groups.replacement: Python Headless Web plus Remote Web feature owners

hard_rules: No candidate in this manifest is deleted automatically.
Actual deletion requires explicit user approval and a focused candidate group.
Deletion must preserve Python Headless Web execution.
Deletion must preserve optional Electron shell execution when the candidate is Electron-related.
Legacy Desktop deletion requires separate feature-parity approval.
